scenarios.evidence: Invitation opens an empty workspace; a five-dialog tour appears before the task; the member cannot dismiss step three.
Guest checkout exists; shipping and tax appear only after payment details; a declined payment clears the address.
Autosave has no visible state; preview has no locale label; rejected content returns without reviewer reason.
